thread:
Maya: Heads up — BlueHarbor case study kickoff. They approved the interview. Need to schedule recording and legal signoff. TL;DR: 30-45m interview, product focus on latency/cost wins.

Devon: Great. I'll own scheduling. What assets do they want quoted?

Sam: They confirmed a 3x token-cost reduction anecdote + 40% latency drop on their peak batch.

Alisha: Legal: send the doc to legal@redwood.com, please. We need to lock quotes and mark embargo date.

Maya: Draft Qs in this doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BlueHarborDraft. Also need exec quote from BH CEO — @Jo can you nudge?

Jo: On it. I have a 20min slot Tues 10:00-10:20 PT. Is that workable?

Devon: Yes. I'll send Zoom and recording consent.

Maya: Consent wording — include 'non-exclusive use for marketing + press.'

LegalBot: Reminder: use template 'Customer Quote Release V2' from /share/legal-templates. Redline must return in 48h.

Noah: Will set up a staging page for embargoed asset — draft URL: https://redwood.com/case-study/blueharbor-draft

Sam: For the benchmark section, can we confirm the baseline model & quant config? BH used Llama-3-8B q4f16 on P4d for their comparatives.

Alisha: Legal needs the raw transcript before publishing.

Maya: Good — recording + raw transcript to @Alisha by EOD Wed. Also add 2 pull quotes and 1 screenshot from their dashboard.

Devon: Scheduling invite sent, Zoom + recording + quick pre-call agenda. Invite includes PR checklist.

Jo: CEO asked for 3 bullet points to prep. Sent via DM.

Maya: :thumbsup: timeline — interview Tue, legal returns by Thu, draft asset ready Fri, publish next Wed (embargo).

Sam: Need approval for the benchmark numbers from eng-ml. @Len can you confirm numbers and sign off?

Len: Confirming the ~40% latency drop and ~3x cost reduction on our test harness. I'll attach the perf report to the doc and sign off.

Alisha: Legal ok with quote language "BlueHarbor reduced inference cost by ~3x using Redwood's cache and batching"?

LegalBot: Suggest 'approximately threefold' for copy. Avoid exact numeric claims unless signed data included in appendix.

Maya: Ok we'll rephrase as 'approximately threefold' and have Len add a signed perf appendix.

Devon: Quick note: customer wants to review the final draft and redline. That's fine — add a review step to the timeline.

Maya: Also planning a 60s launch social post + blog + benchmark deep dive. Need one standout metric and a quote for the blog header.

Sam: Proposed header: 'BlueHarbor cuts inference unit cost by approximately threefold with Redwood caching and batching.'

Alisha: Legal: please approve subject-line and header language before publish.

Len: Perf report uploaded to the doc. Numbers come from their production traces + our side-by-side harness.

Maya: Pre-call agenda (included in the invite):
```text
Pre-call agenda:
- 5m intros
- 10m product walkthrough
- 15m quant/benchmarks (Len to share)
- 10m quotes & closing
```

Jo: CEO wants a one-paragraph testimonial ready after the call to speed approvals.

Noah: I'll capture a short clip (30s) of the dashboard for the blog. Will link the asset here.

Maya: Action items — Devon: send invite + consent; Len: perf appendix + signoff; Alisha: legal review; Jo: CEO prep; Noah: assets.

Devon: Done. Invite has consent + agenda + doc link.

Alisha: Reviewing now. Will return redlines by Thu morning.

Maya: Thanks team. If legal or eng needs more time, push publish back one week. I'll own comms and final QA.

LegalBot: Note: embargo date must be set in the doc metadata field 'embargo_date' to be recognized by the release pipeline.

Maya: Added embargo_date: 2026-06-10. Will confirm after legal signoff.

Devon: Marking Trello card to 'in legal review'.

Jo: Thanks all — CEO prepped. See you on Tue.

Sam: 👍

Maya: Closing thread for now; will reopen if blockers appear."
